label: full-B01
brief: A 10-second widescreen (16:9) silent clip. A small neighbourhood barber shop on a quiet weekday afternoon: one black leather chair in front of a wide mirror with round bulbs, a worn wooden counter with clippers, combs and a talc brush, a striped pole outside the front window, warm tungsten light inside and soft daylight from the window. Marcus, the barber, mid-forties, shaved head, grey beard, black apron over a white t-shirt. Dev, the customer, early twenties, in the chair with a black cape, short dark hair being finished into a fade. Marcus finishes the fade on Dev's right side with the clippers, steps back, tilts his head to check the line, then picks up the talc brush and dusts Dev's neck. Dev looks into the mirror. End on Marcus lifting the cape at Dev's shoulders, about to take it off.

clip.prompt: 10-second silent text-to-video naturalistic film insert of barber Marcus finishing customer Dev’s haircut in a small neighbourhood barber shop on a quiet weekday afternoon, widescreen 16:9. Live-action realism, warm tungsten bulbs mixed with soft window daylight, an unhurried mood, worn wood and supple black leather; energy is gentle and precise. One continuous shot, the same Marcus, Dev, wardrobe, haircut and shop layout throughout. Marcus is mid-forties, shaved-headed with a grey beard, wearing a black apron over a white T-shirt; Dev is early twenties with short dark hair and a nearly finished fade, seated under a black cape. 0–3 s: medium three-quarter view from Dev’s right, Marcus, grey beard visible, makes one final upward clipper pass along Dev’s right-side fade; the single black leather chair faces a wide mirror edged with round bulbs, above a worn counter holding combs and a talc brush. Begin a slow, shallow camera push toward their mirror reflection. 3–6 s: medium framing, Marcus, grey beard visible and head tilted in appraisal from a half-step back, dusts Dev’s neck with the talc brush taken from the counter; Dev’s gaze remains on his reflection. Continue the gentle push, keeping the brush and neckline visible; through the front window at frame left, a small striped barber pole is visible just outside at roughly head height. 6–10 s: medium-close framing on the shoulders and reflected faces, Marcus, grey beard visible, lifts the cape slightly at Dev’s shoulders, poised to remove it; the warm round mirror bulbs remain behind them. Ease the camera to a stop by 8 s and hold this still, clearly readable image through 10 s, cape still attached. Audio off. Warm, restrained grade with natural skin tones and soft contrast; measured pacing. Negatives: no cuts, extra people or chairs, cape removal, subsequent haircut reveal, exaggerated talc cloud, distorted reflections, flicker, text, logos or watermarks.
